messages.subject: Documenting Rcpp11 changes
parts:
Would appreciate if you add a NEWS file to Rcpp11.

I noticed a new version came out but the only way to discover what has changed is to clone it in git and then examine the change log, etc.

messages.author: deea3c30b4c8409f
messages.subject: Re: [R-and-cpp] Documenting Rcpp11 changes
parts:
This is not really a replacement of a NEWS file, but you don't need to clone it, you can look at the diff online at https://github.com/cran/Rcpp11, more specifically https://github.com/cran/Rcpp11/commit/50a34b9ad2c0c025ec4434cc3a41c0a4cbc40974

Gabor
